unit.title: Percent, Financial Mathematics & Change
unit.essential_question: How can percent and financial mathematics help us measure change, compare choices, and make transparent decisions?
big_ideas: Percent is a rate per hundred that connects fractions, decimals, and proportional reasoning.
Percent problems depend on identifying the part, rate, and reference whole.
Relative change compares a difference with the original value.
Financial calculations must name the base, order, time period, and fees.
Responsible decisions compare total outcomes and communicate assumptions and limitations.
unit.architecture: Integrated Grade 9 learning: instruction + reasoning + practice + application + tools + reflection + mastery
unit.tool_integration: Use calculators and Verve Arithmetic as optional reasoning/checking tools after students establish a mathematical model.

lessons.title: Percent Meaning, Benchmarks & Equivalent Forms
objectives: Interpret percent as a rate per one hundred.
Convert among fractions, decimals, and percents.
Use benchmark percents to estimate quantities.
Distinguish the part, whole, and percent rate in context.

lessons.title: Finding a Percent of a Quantity
objectives: Find a percent of a quantity using multiplication.
Use benchmark decomposition for mental percent calculations.
Write and evaluate part = rate × whole equations.
Estimate before calculating exact percent amounts.

lessons.title: Finding the Percent Rate or the Whole
objectives: Find the percent rate when the part and whole are known.
Find the whole when a part and percent are known.
Solve percent problems with equations and proportions.
Identify which quantity represents 100% before calculating.

lessons.title: Percent Increase, Decrease & Relative Change
objectives: Calculate absolute and relative change.
Find percent increase and percent decrease.
Use multipliers to calculate new values efficiently.
Explain why percent change uses the original value as the denominator.

lessons.title: Discounts, Tax, Tips & Commission
objectives: Calculate discounts and sale prices.
Calculate tax, tips, and commissions.
Combine sequential charges and reductions accurately.
Distinguish a percent amount from the final total.

lessons.title: Markup, Profit, Loss & Break-Even
objectives: Calculate markup amounts and selling prices.
Calculate profit and loss in dollars and percents.
Distinguish markup on cost from margin on selling price.
Interpret fixed and variable costs in break-even reasoning.

lessons.title: Simple Interest, Fees & Financial Comparisons
objectives: Calculate simple interest using I=Prt.
Find total amount after simple interest.
Compare savings or borrowing options with rates and fees.
Align time units with the stated interest period.

lessons.title: Percentage Points, Repeated Change & Financial Decisions
objectives: Distinguish percentage-point change from percent change.
Calculate successive percent changes using updated values.
Compare financial options using total cost, benefit, and assumptions.
Communicate limitations and ethical considerations in percent-based claims.

practice.title: Foundation Practice
practice.description: Scaffolded percent models, benchmark support, and guided financial calculations.

practice.title: Core Practice
practice.description: Complete unit practice across percent, change, pricing, interest, and decisions.

practice.title: Extended Practice
practice.description: Error analysis, repeated change, financial comparison, and unfamiliar contexts.

tools.title: Verve Arithmetic
tools.purpose: Optional percent and arithmetic exploration/checking tool.
